name: @openlance/aios-runtime-execution-engine
description: Phase 4 Stage 10 Runtime Execution Engine: the Runtime's operational execution subsystem, the operational realization of the frozen ai/runtime model. It consumes an immutable ExecutionRequest (ExecutionPlan + GovernanceDecision + SafetyDecision + ExecutionContext), verifies the governance/safety preconditions, and executes an authorized and safe plan by driving the frozen execution state machine and orchestrating steps over an injected step-execution seam, with bounded retry/timeout/cancellation/recovery/checkpointing and deterministic result aggregation. It never authorizes, evaluates safety, selects a provider, or overrides an upstream decision, holds no vendor knowledge, and is deterministic in orchestration (ADR-0044).
